The '''suppression of Ghorman''',<ref name="Ever Been" /> also known as the '''rebellion on Ghorman''',<ref name="Make It Stop">{{Andor|Make It Stop}}</ref> was a covert campaign initiated by the [[Galactic Empire]] by the [[Standard year|year]] [[4 BBY]]. The operation was centered around the [[planet]] [[Ghorman]], which the Empire had discovered was home to a depository of [[kalkite]], a material necessary for [[reactor]] lenses<ref name="Ever Been" /> on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]].<ref name="World Building">{{SWYouTube|series=Andor Declassified|text=World Building|video=3ihBfycg8Wg|sw_url=video/world-building-andor-season-2-declassified-content-contains-spoilers}}</ref> The gouge-[[mining]] was set to be an invasive, destructive progress that would call for the planet's suppression and abandonment. Planning for the campaign was carried out by the [[Ghorman project]] thinktank, who started with the work of the [[Ministry of Enlightenment]] and its [[anti-Ghorman whispering campaign]] designed to turn [[Galaxy|galactic]] opinion against Ghorman to justify the Empire's actions against the [[Ghorman (people)|Ghorman population]]. By that time, Ghorman had already been subject to the ministry's [[propaganda]]. Furthermore, it had been the site of controversary thanks to the [[Blockade of Ghorman shipping lanes|cutoff of Ghorman shipping lanes]]<ref name="One Year Later" /> and [[Ghorman Debates]].<ref name="RiseFall">''[[Star Wars: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]''</ref>

At the suggestion of [[ISB Supervisor]] [[Dedra Meero]],<ref name="One Year Later" /> who would be given control over the project,<ref name="Sagrona Teema">{{Andor|Sagrona Teema}}</ref> the Empire allowed the local [[Ghorman Front]] to grow bolder<ref name="WAFE" /> so as to give the Empire an excuse to crackdown, with the Empire also arranging a false flag [[Firebombing at the Imperial Naval Terminal|firebombing of the Ghorman Naval Terminal]]<ref name="Messenger" /> in [[2 BBY]].<ref name="2BBY" /> Shortly thereafter, events culminated in the [[Ghorman Massacre]],<ref name="WHO?" /> where the Empire slaughtered peaceful protesters<ref name="ROUVG">''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]''</ref> who had taken to the streets in protest to the Empire's crackdown.<ref name="WHO?" /> The Empire painted the Ghormans as the aggressors and carried out the [[Arrest of Dasi Oran|arrest]] of Ghorman [[Senator]] [[Dasi Oran]], who begged his fellow senators to take notice of his world's fate. While many senators accepted the Imperial narrative, Senator [[Mon Mothma]]—herself already a secret rebel organizer—took to the [[Imperial Senate]] to condemn the massacre as a genocide and declare [[Galactic Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] as a monster. Afterward, she [[Escape from the Senate|escaped from the Senate]]<ref name="Welcome" /> and [[Declaration of the Rebel Alliance|officially formed]] the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="Secret Cargo">{{Rebels|Secret Cargo}}</ref>
